expect: the agent workspace uploading a real card image, running the DING detector/checklist, and saving the reviewed card on desktop.

response.scene_summary: The clip demonstrates the agent workspace workflow for processing a card image. A user uploads a 'roboflow-tauros-real-card.jpg' image, which triggers an automated DING detector checklist. The system processes the image through several steps, calculates a confidence score, and then saves the reviewed card locally.
key_observations: A card image named 'roboflow-tauros-real-card.jpg' is successfully uploaded and displayed in the 'Agent chat' and 'Active item' sections.

The 'Run checklist' section actively processes all steps: 'Card detected', 'Edges visible', 'Blur check passed', 'Glare check passed', 'Perspective normalized', 'Front/back recognized', 'Corner regions extracted', and 'Edge regions extracted'.
The 'Active item' confidence updates from 0% to 62% after the checklist completes.
The 'Review state' indicates 'No visible DING candidates exceeded the current threshold. Human review still recommended.'
A 'TOOL' message confirms 'Saved roboflow-tauros-real-card.jpg. Persistence: local. Evidence manifest and report data remain auditable.' in the chat.
